subject: Weekly MAP: finance gate & pricing alignment for Acero
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Feldman <jordan.feldman@acerohealth.com>, procurement@acerohealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — finance gate & pricing alignment

Jordan / Acero team —

Thanks for the sync earlier. Per our MAP cadence, sharing a concise status and the specific asks we need to close:

Agenda / asks for this week:
- Confirm target commit size and timeline (visible to procurement + CFO)
- Finalize discount band and credit ask (if any) for procurement approval
- Identify internal approvals required (pricing cap, credit authority, legal redline)

Current assumptions:
- Target ARR commit: ~$500k over 12 months
- Suggested discount band: 10–20% (depends on commit and term)
- One-time onboarding credit: TBD by finance

Attached: Acero_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP with milestone dates) and Acero_Pricing_Request.xlsx (procurement asks table).

Proposed next steps:
1) Jordan to confirm CFO’s target discount and any requested credits by EOD Tuesday.
2) Internal pricing review on Wednesday (Vivek/Rafael) — can provisionally approve up to a threshold.
3) DocuSign ready once we agree pricing/commit.

Please flag anything I missed. If helpful, we can do a 15-min pricing breakout tomorrow.

—Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Acero_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP), Acero_Pricing_Request.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jordan Feldman <jordan.feldman@acerohealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acerohealth.com, Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@acerohealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — finance gate & pricing alignment

Thanks Camila — quick update from our side: we ran the numbers with procurement and the CFO.

High level:
- CFO signaled target: 20% discount on list pricing, contingent on a $500k commit over 12 months.
- Procurement is also asking for a one-time implementation credit of $50k to offset transition costs.
- Timeline: procurement needs final commercial terms by July 5 to include in next quarter’s budget.

We can accept a structured commit (50% upfront, remainder monthly) if that helps meet the discount.

I’ll share any redlines from procurement as soon as they’re available.

—Jordan
Jordan Feldman | Director, Strategic Partnerships | Acero Health
jordan.feldman@acerohealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Acero pricing ask (20% + $50k credit) — need internal signoff

Forwarding Jordan’s note — procurement is asking for 20% + $50k onboarding credit; target commit $500k, sign by July 5.

Immediate questions for pricing/finance/legal:
- What’s our max approveable discount without CEO approval?
- Is a $50k one-time credit feasible against ARR target (how to treat vs. revenue recognition)?
- If we counter 15% + $25k credit with $475k commit, do we expect acceptance?

Quick asks (owners):
- Rafael: can you run a margin/discount model and flag approval threshold?
- Neha: can finance confirm whether $25k credit can be absorbed in current quarter or needs exec sign-off?
- Vivek/Marissa: thoughts on concession strategy — tradeoffs (case studies welcome).

I’ve attached the latest MAP and pricing workbook. I’d like internal responses by EOD Tuesday so I can get back to Jordan on Wednesday.

—Camila

Attachment: Acero_MAP_v2.pdf, Acero_Pricing_Request.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acero pricing ask (20% + $50k credit) — need internal signoff

Thanks Camila. My initial read:
- 20% + $50k credit is above standard band for this ARR profile without exec approval.
- I can provisionally approve up to 15% and a $25k one-time credit if we close at $450k commit and term is 12 months (we should prioritize ARR not just TCV).
- If Acero will do $500k commit and 60% upfront, we can stretch to 17% discount and $35k credit pending Rafael’s margin calc.

Recommend we present a counter: 17% discount + $25k credit + $475k commit. That keeps us within margin guardrails and gets close to their ask. Rafael — need your margin delta and any escalations required. Neha — confirm finance treatment + whether $25k requires exec sign-off.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement if Camila wants me there.

—Vivek

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing impact & approval path — Acero

Quick modeling notes after running the workbook:
- 20% + $50k credit against $500k ARR reduces first-year gross margin by ~6.8% (baseline list assumptions).
- 15% + $25k credit against $450k commit yields ~3.6% margin erosion — within pricing ops tolerance for strategic accounts.
- Exec escalation required if discount >17% or credit >$30k.

Approval path (recommended):
1) Pricing ops (Rafael) signs off for discounts <=17% and credits <=$30k.
2) VP Sales (Vivek) must approve any deviation up to those thresholds.
3) Anything beyond goes to Chief Revenue Officer / CEO for approval.

Action items (owners):
- Rafael: finalize model and upload to drive (done) -> link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_acero_MAP
- Neha: confirm finance treatment for $25k credit (deferred vs. contra revenue) by EOD 6/17.
- Camila: present counter to Jordan with suggested structure.

I’ll prepare the pricing appendix for the deal doc once we lock the numbers.

—Rafael

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Feldman <jordan.feldman@acerohealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, procurement@acerohealth.com
Date: 2026-06-17T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed commercial terms — Acero (request for signoff by July 5)

Jordan — thanks for the transparency. Based on internal review we can propose the following compromise to present to your CFO/procurement: 

Proposed terms:
- Commit: $475,000 ARR (12 months)
- Discount: 18% off list (applied to ARR)
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 (applied as credit within first invoice cycle)
- Billing: 50% upfront, remainder monthly
- Legal: standard SOW & data handling addendum (we’ll circulate redlines)

Rationale: this keeps us within internal approval thresholds while materially closing the gap to your request. Rafael confirmed that discounts above 17% or credits >$30k require exec escalation — we are offering 18% and $25k credit with pricing ops sign-off and Vivek’s buy-in.

Next steps: 
- If you can get CFO sign-off on these terms, I’ll route a DocuSign pack and share the HubSpot deal record for procurement (links below). Target signoff by July 5 to hit your budget window.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/seed/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACR-2026-094

Let me know if you want a quick call with Vivek to close this out.

—Camila

From: Jordan Feldman <jordan.feldman@acerohealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@acerohealth.com>, procurement@acerohealth.com
Date: 2026-06-20T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms — Acero (request for signoff by July 5)

Camila — appreciate the flexibility. CFO reviewed and is comfortable moving forward with the proposed compromise: 18% discount + $25k credit + $475k commit. Procurement will accept the billing cadence and wants DocuSign.

We’ll sign the DocuSign package this week; expect executed agreement by June 24. Thanks for the quick turnaround — Jordan

(internal note) From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoint — capture approval and next actions

Final internal log: Acero verbally accepted counter (18% / $25k / $475k). Rafael confirmed pricing ops sign-off; Neha confirmed finance will treat credit as contra revenue and can absorb within quarter. I’ve queued DocuSign and will update HubSpot once signed.

Owners: 
- Camila: send DocuSign & finalize insertion order (done)
- Marissa: CS onboarding kickoff once agreement executed
- Rafael: load pricing appendix to deal record
- Neha: confirm revenue recognition entry post-signature

Closing note: target to have executed agreement and kickoff scheduled by June 30.

—Camila
